CapabilityProviders.description: Capabilities a subscription may serve; each defaults to its local model.
CapabilityProviders.title: CapabilityProviders

ChatMessage-Input.description: Unified chat message supporting text, images, reasoning, and tool calls.
ChatMessage-Input.title: ChatMessage

ChatMessage-Output.description: Unified chat message supporting text, images, reasoning, and tool calls.
ChatMessage-Output.title: ChatMessage

conversation_id.description: Client-owned opaque conversation ID; omitted IDs never retain prefix state.
conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

max_tokens.description: Cap on generated tokens, including reasoning. Omit to allow the remaining context.
max_tokens.title: Max Tokens

priority.description: Interactive turns run ahead of queued background turns between requests.
priority.title: Priority

reasoning_tokens.description: Reasoning is closed after this many tokens so the reply keeps its share of max_tokens.
reasoning_tokens.title: Reasoning Tokens

reuse_prefix.description: Disable to compare against full prefill.
reuse_prefix.title: Reuse Prefix

next_batch_capacity.description: Advisory image capacity for a subsequent compatible batch; admission is rechecked when it runs.
next_batch_capacity.title: Next Batch Capacity

MessagesResponse.description: Compatibility envelope for client-owned conversations; the server has no history.
MessagesResponse.title: MessagesResponse

MetricsResponse.description:
Process-local request statistics plus best-effort host/device memory samples.

Null latency/error statistics mean no retained samples in the window. A
truncated window covers retained records only; Online does not imply a
loaded model or successful GPU inference.
MetricsResponse.title: MetricsResponse

ModelAssignments.description: Fixed capability assignments, independent of machine resources.
ModelAssignments.title: ModelAssignments

value.description: Probability that the criterion is true.
value.title: Value

RequestRecord.description:
Completed HTTP-handler observation retained only in the current API process.

The legacy prompt/output fields contain structural and HTTP summaries, not
user text or model output. Latency includes validation and cleanup; it is
not a token throughput or time-to-first-token measurement. Optional native
timings measure admission/prefill to the first generated token, prefill-only
work, and decode after that token. Stream TTFT measures HTTP arrival to the
first content event passed to ASGI (not browser receipt). Missing data is null.
RequestRecord.title: RequestRecord

RequestResponse.description: Wrap a single retained HTTP observation for the detail endpoint.
RequestResponse.title: RequestResponse

RequestsResponse.description: A page of retained observations with its filtered total and process epoch.
RequestsResponse.title: RequestsResponse

ResourceMeter.description: Observed host or device-wide memory in GiB, including other processes.
ResourceMeter.title: ResourceMeter

value.description: Expected zero-based ordinal rubric index; may be fractional.
value.title: Value

SubscriptionLogin.description: A web sign-in in progress; `url` opens the provider's sign-in page.

needs_code.description: Claude: its sign-in page shows a code to send back to Hikari.
needs_code.title: Needs Code

user_code.description: Codex: the one-time code to enter on its sign-in page.
user_code.title: User Code

SubscriptionLogin.title: SubscriptionLogin

audio.description: Base64 mono 16-bit PCM WAV data URL at 16000 Hz
audio.title: Audio

formatting.description: Null or omitted uses the saved formatting setting. Enabled uses S1-mini by Superwhisper to normalize the transcript; raw_text is always retained.
formatting.title: Formatting

batch_collection_target.description: Expected image count in the submitting cohort. Only shortens collection waiting; queued compatible requests may still share a larger admitted batch.
batch_collection_target.title: Batch Collection Target

image.description: PNG data URL, at most 20 MiB. Dimensions must be multiples of 32, at most 3072 per side and 4,718,592 pixels. Reference inputs must contain at least 65,536 pixels. Source mode uses the source dimensions; reference mode accepts an independent target width and height.
image.title: Image

mask.description: Opaque PNG matching the source size. Black preserves pixels, white edits them; gray blends.
mask.title: Mask

mode.description: Source edits noise the input image. Reference edits generate a new image conditioned on one or more reference images.
mode.title: Mode

reference_images.description: Optional additional PNG reference data URLs for reference mode, ordered after image (up to 4 total references).
reference_images.title: Reference Images

strength.description: Image-to-image noise strength. Zero preserves the source; one regenerates the editable area from noise. Describe the desired result in prompt.
strength.title: Strength

batch_collection_target.description: Expected image count in the submitting cohort. Only shortens collection waiting; queued compatible requests may still share a larger admitted batch.
batch_collection_target.title: Batch Collection Target

model_id.description: Omit to use the image model selected in Settings.
model_id.title: Model Id

provider.description: Omit to use the image provider in Settings. Local explicitly preserves native generation, including pet stages.
provider.title: Provider

steps.description: Inference step count. FLUX.2 Klein 4B Distilled uses its fixed four-step schedule.
steps.title: Steps

info.description: Local model downloads and selection are persisted. Each machine runs one native C++ process with a worker per inference type; workers connect to /v1/workers and own their engines and queues. The API grants every worker its memory budget by priority, routes requests, and presents native results. Chat history is client-owned.
info.title: Hikari API

get.description: Return current model state, context limits and shared-memory accounting without loading a model.

post.description: Request cooperative cancellation and wait for model cleanup before returning unloaded state.

get.description: Return empty speech history and blank editor defaults, without fixture audio.

post.description: Queue native speech; cancellation waits for owned cleanup.

get.description: Expose only enabled native checkpoint integrations.

post.description: Queue native Whisper and preserve its raw transcript and formatting status.
Queue JSON or incremental SSE chat; disconnect waits for native cleanup.

get.description: Chat is stateless on the server. Conversations are held by the calling client; no persisted messages are available.
Return blank playground state; no saved questions or model answers are loaded.

post.description: Queue typed single-pass decisions on the language model, preserving validation and disconnect cleanup.

get.description: Return empty history; generated image bytes are returned directly and not persisted.

post.description: Submit source or reference image editing to the shared worker.
Generate through the selected provider, or explicitly use Local.

Join an active image request's cleanup before acknowledging cancellation.

An absent request has no recoverable result here. Callers must distinguish
that from a confirmed cancellation and reconcile their durable output first.

get.description:
Combine a fresh memory sample with the bounded telemetry snapshot.

This monitoring read is excluded from generation telemetry, so polling
does not increase request counts or feed back into latency statistics.
Return the worker's latest model snapshot and observed download progress.

post.description: Queue a worker download; poll model status for progress and completion.

get.description:
Filter a newest-first snapshot and return the requested page.

Search matches IDs, endpoints, catalog IDs and safe summaries. Totals cover
retained matches only; concurrent completions or eviction can move records
between successive page requests. No database history is consulted.

Return a retained observation by ID, or 404 after eviction or restart.

The lookup uses a snapshot, so it never holds the telemetry lock while
serializing the response.
